description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
1.) When the lost are resurrected what will they be clothed (clothes)with and what will they eat.
.
2.) I'm struggling to reconcile the KJV errors in translation with the other translations of Revelation 5:9,10. Why does Revelation 5:10 use ημας whilst others use αυτους? How to explain this issue without indirectly discouraging someone's confidence in God's word?
.
3.) Shouting & Clapping While Sharing the Message?
.
.
Join us every Tuesday at 4:30pm (Pacific Time) for our weekly episode airing LIVE from the studio!
Only on SUMtv.org! 
Additional Bible studies are available at SecretsUnsealed.org.
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program.
